title: ED safeguarding documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports asking permission to document and recording complaints, symptoms, signs, injuries and relevant history in the person’s words without interpretation.
user_facing_items.population: Women subjected to intimate partner violence or sexual violence; the handbook does not directly address people under 18 or men.
user_facing_items.setting: Health-care encounters including first-line support, history, examination and documentation.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: International guidance requiring UAE legal, safeguarding and referral adaptation
restrictions: Exact for survivor-centred first-line support, consent to documentation, recording complaints, symptoms, signs and injuries, and history or examination only when clinically performed. It is not authority for universal screening or automatic reporting in the UAE.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports child-centred, private and accessible communication, consent to examination, and recording actual words and disagreements.
user_facing_items.population: Children and young people under 18, including unborn babies, who may be at risk of or experiencing abuse or neglect, and their parents or carers.
user_facing_items.setting: Health, emergency, social-care and other services encountering children and families.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: England and Wales; UAE safeguarding law and pathways govern local use
restrictions: Exact for child-centred communication, consent to examination, recording actual words, non-leading exploration, observing the child and relationships, and clinician-led safeguarding action. It does not assert abuse or replace UAE reporting requirements.
user_facing_items.rationale: For children and young people, the exact NICE section supports recording patient concerns, consent-based assessment and completed risk or consent discussion in the child’s actual words where appropriate.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recognising indirect disclosure, using open non-leading questions, explaining next steps and recording local safeguarding referral when clinician-completed.
